title: Compute the Diversity sub-index — compute_diversity
text: Diversity counts distinct plant species (cash crops, forages cover crops alike) grown window-year span unit's evaluation window, sliding one calendar year time, averages counts. record window years fewer single span. default 4-year window corn-soybean rotation counts 2 species, corn-soybean-wheat 3, rye cover grown rotation adds 1; long stand single perennial counts 1 except spans meets next crop. window = 1 counts species per calendar year. Species. distinct CD_name species (whitespace tidied). Count-first placeholder mixtures "8-species", "8 spp" "8-species mix" count many species. Names joined "+" split. Rows named "fallow", "none" "bare" plants. Score. $$Diversity = 100 \min\left(\frac{R - 1}{R_{max} - 1}, 1\right)$$ \(R\) average richness per window: one species scores 0, \(R_{max}\) (8) scores 100.
